summary: Pitanium Ltd (Nasdaq: PTNM) filed a Form 6-K on July 17, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq delisting determination letter dated July 7, 2026. The delisting stems from a prior SEC trading suspension on October 3, 2025 due to suspected social-media-driven manipulation. Nasdaq cited Listing Rule IM-5101-4, allowing it to delist over third-party misconduct concerns without finding company wrongdoing. Unless appealed by July 14, trading was to be suspended July 16, 2026. The company will evaluate next steps with counsel; securities may trade OTC. Watch for any appeal or subsequent OTC market liquidity.
